units.source_text: 我四五岁时，姐姐就被收养在亲戚家中。

en.t: When I was four or five, my elder sister was taken in by relatives.

units.source_text: 我十一二岁那年，她便在那家离开了尘世。

en.t: The year I was eleven or twelve, she passed away in that house.

units.source_text: 我不了解姐姐，就如同不了解我父母一样。

en.t: I did not know my sister, just as I did not know my parents.

units.source_text: 祖父对姐姐的死十分哀伤，也硬迫着我哀伤。

en.t: My grandfather grieved deeply over my sister's death, and he forced me to grieve as well.

units.source_text: 我搜索枯肠，也不知该以什么样的感情、寄托在什么东西上才能表达我的悲痛。

en.t: No matter how hard I searched my mind, I did not know what feeling I should have, or what I could place it in, to express my sorrow.

units.source_text: 只是老弱的祖父悲恸欲绝，他的形象刺透了我的心。

en.t: Only the sight of my old and frail grandfather, overcome with grief, pierced my heart.

units.source_text: 我的感情只倾泻在祖父的身上，并没有越过祖父，进一步移向姐姐。

en.t: My feelings poured only toward my grandfather, and did not pass beyond him to move further toward my sister.

units.source_text: 祖父精通易学，擅长占卜。

en.t: My grandfather was well versed in the Book of Changes and skilled at divination.

units.source_text: 晚年患眼疾，近乎双目失明。

en.t: In his later years he suffered from an eye disease and was nearly blind in both eyes.

units.source_text: 一听说姐姐危笃，他便悄悄地数起竹签，占卜孙女的命运。

en.t: As soon as he heard that my sister was critically ill, he quietly began counting bamboo sticks to divine his granddaughter's fate.

units.source_text: 老人视力衰退，我帮着他一边排列占卜用具，一边目不转睛地盯着老人渐渐暗淡无光的脸。

en.t: With the old man's eyesight failing, I helped him arrange the divination tools while staring fixedly at his face as it gradually grew dim and lifeless.

units.source_text: 过了两三天，便传来了姐姐的噩耗。

en.t: Two or three days later, the terrible news of my sister's death arrived.

units.source_text: 我不忍心当即告诉祖父，将信压下两三个小时，才下决心念给他听。

en.t: I could not bear to tell my grandfather at once, so I kept the letter back for two or three hours before finally resolving to read it to him.

units.source_text: 那时候，我可以读一般的汉字，遇上不认识的草书，

en.t: At that time, I could read ordinary Chinese characters, but when I came across cursive writing I did not know,

units.source_text: 就握住祖父的手，用我的手指三番数次地在祖父的掌心上描画那些字的形状，学着念给他听。

en.t: I would take my grandfather's hand and trace the shapes of those characters again and again on his palm with my finger, learning them and reading them aloud to him.
This had already become a habit.

units.source_text: 现在我想起读那封信时同祖父握手的感觉，不由得觉得自己的左掌心也是冷冰冰的。

en.t: Now, when I remember the feeling of holding my grandfather's hand as I read that letter, I cannot help feeling that my own left palm is cold as well.
